headline:
I don't just train models — *I ship them*,
to production and to the edge.
paragraphs: I'm an AI Software Engineer with 2+ years building and running real-time AI systems — not notebooks, but systems that run in production and on the edge.

Today I own the camera-processing service and the GPU model-serving layer of NEXA, a real-time video-analytics platform watching live CCTV for UK clients, including a Premier League stadium. Before that, on Lambda Theta's offshore team for ELM (Saudi Arabia), I built model-serving backends for vision products and ran the MLflow model registry for the team building NUHA, an Arabic large language model.

My path runs from real-time computer vision on NVIDIA Jetson, through model serving and MLOps, to taking video analytics from cloud GPUs down to edge devices. I care about measured trade-offs — numbers verified on the target hardware, not assumed.

stats.label: Detection pipelines on the camera framework I built
From Jetson devices to cloud GPU servers
